stem_book: The figure shows four penguins that are being playfully pulled along very slippery (frictionless) ice by a curator. From the back: 12 kg, (unknown mass), 15 kg, 20 kg, linked by cords; the tension in the cord between the unknown penguin and the 15 kg penguin is 111 N, and the tension in the cord pulled by the curator (attached to the 20 kg penguin) is 222 N. Calculate the penguin mass (in kg) which is not given.
